statement.zh: 高拉土丘联合发掘的连续居住层见 Speiser《高拉发掘》I（1935）与 Tobler 第 II 卷（1950）。
statement.en: At Tepe Gawra, successive occupational levels from the joint expedition are documented in Speiser Excavations at Tepe Gawra I (1935) and Tobler Volume II (1950).
